inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL-mode string-function reference places REGEXP_SUBSTR extraction beside ordered GROUP_CONCAT aggregation examples.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored incident-channel report. A LEFT JOIN preserves channels with no matching tokens, REGEXP_SUBSTR extracts the first incident code per message, NULLIF removes MariaDB's empty no-match result, and ordered GROUP_CONCAT plus COUNT summarizes each channel. The reference examples, schema, values, and documentation context are not copied.

fixture_notes: Channel 201 has two incident codes and one message without a code; extraction keeps the first code from each matching message and ordered aggregation returns AB-204|CD-9. Channel 202 has only missing or nonmatching text, so the left-joined group returns the fallback label none and token count zero.
determinism_notes: Channel IDs, message IDs, message text, regex pattern, aggregate ordering, and final channel ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE incident_channels (channel_id INT PRIMARY KEY, channel_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE channel_messages (message_id INT PRIMARY KEY, channel_id INT NOT NULL, message_text VARCHAR(160) NULL)

INSERT INTO channel_messages VALUES (3001, 201, 'Deploy ticket AB-204 is queued'), (3002, 201, 'Escalation CD-9 then EF-11'), (3003, 201, 'Routine heartbeat only'), (3004, 202, NULL), (3005, 202, 'Maintenance window complete')

steps.sql: SELECT c.channel_id, c.channel_name, COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(REGEXP_SUBSTR(m.message_text, '[A-Z]{2}-[0-9]+'), '') ORDER BY m.message_id SEPARATOR '|'), 'none') AS incident_tokens, COUNT(NULLIF(REGEXP_SUBSTR(m.message_text, '[A-Z]{2}-[0-9]+'), '')) AS token_count FROM incident_channels AS c LEFT JOIN channel_messages AS m ON m.channel_id = c.channel_id GROUP BY c.channel_id, c.channel_name ORDER BY c.channel_id

checks.sql: SELECT channel_id, channel_name FROM incident_channels ORDER BY channel_id
SELECT message_id, channel_id, message_text FROM channel_messages ORDER BY message_id
